time_span: 19:10 to next day 07:00 during one severe rain night
premise: A small riverside public library stays open as a heat/rain shelter while rising water, a records-access dispute, volunteer shortages and a delayed municipal decision force staff and local residents to redistribute authority before morning.

characters.name: 이정은
characters.state: competent and protective but habitually absorbs every final decision
characters.private_pressure: received notice that her mother may need assisted living and must answer a care-center call by morning
characters.arc: learn to distribute operational authority without disappearing from responsibility

characters.name: 최민재
characters.state: technically capable, cautious after a past drainage-call delay
characters.arc: own a time-critical safety decision under his own name

characters.name: 김소라
characters.state: protects staff boundaries and distrusts emergency improvisation that becomes permanent unpaid labor
characters.arc: accept a temporary exception only if its end condition and successor owner are explicit

characters.name: 박영호
characters.role: retired teacher and senior volunteer captain
characters.state: knows local patrons and flood history but hides worsening hearing difficulty
characters.arc: transfer local knowledge instead of remaining the indispensable messenger

characters.name: 윤가람
characters.state: responsible for shelter-support grant reporting but lacks formal command authority
characters.arc: turn compliance records into usable field coordination rather than paperwork

characters.name: 강지수
characters.role: nearby basement-bookshop owner and residents' committee member
characters.state: library critic after a previous closure notice arrived late
characters.arc: move from adversarial monitoring to owning a neighborhood-side decision and future obligation

event_ecology.mechanism: Upstream rainfall causes the river authority to advance a flood-watch threshold; basement backflow risk rises before the library itself is ordered closed.
event_ecology.second_order: A safety decision for the library changes whether nearby basement shops can use the library loading ramp as temporary dry storage.

event_ecology.mechanism: The city opens the library as an overnight cooling/rain shelter but the formal closure authority remains with an off-site duty officer whose callback is delayed.
event_ecology.second_order: Temporary staffing choices become a labor-governance issue that must be reviewed after the emergency.

event_ecology.mechanism: A resident requests CCTV footage from a prior bicycle theft just as staff need the same camera system for flood-door monitoring; privacy and emergency access collide.
event_ecology.second_order: The access method chosen tonight becomes a future rule for emergency use of patron-facing surveillance systems.

event_ecology.mechanism: C04's hearing difficulty makes radio instructions unreliable during loud rain, exposing dependence on his unwritten local knowledge.
event_ecology.second_order: C04 must create and transfer a route/contact map, changing who can coordinate neighborhood checks next time.

event_ecology.mechanism: A shelter-support grant is approved but cannot pay same-night taxi/meal costs without a named emergency purchaser and receipt chain.
event_ecology.second_order: The emergency purchase arrangement creates a next-meeting obligation to define compensated emergency roles.

event_ecology.mechanism: A clipped social-media video suggests staff are turning wet residents away, though the actual restriction concerns the flooded basement entrance.
event_ecology.second_order: C06 must publicly correct the misleading clip, becoming accountable to the same community audience she usually mobilizes against the library.

sequences.title: 비가 선을 넘기 전
sequences.goal: Establish ordinary night duty, rising river risk and centralized decision habit.

sequences.title: 대피소가 된 도서관
sequences.goal: Shelter designation creates staffing and authority ambiguity.

sequences.title: 카메라를 누가 보는가
sequences.goal: Privacy/records conflict makes emergency monitoring a governance choice.

sequences.title: 들리지 않는 무전
sequences.goal: C04's hidden limitation turns local knowledge into a transfer problem.

sequences.title: 오늘 밤 쓸 수 있는 돈
sequences.goal: Approved-but-unusable support forces named purchasing responsibility.

sequences.title: 물은 지하에서 먼저 온다
sequences.goal: Flood risk becomes operational; distributed owners must make irreversible local choices.

sequences.title: 잘린 영상
sequences.goal: Public trust crisis forces C06 to own an outward-facing correction rather than only criticize.

sequences.title: 누가 밤을 이어받는가
sequences.goal: Staff fatigue and shelter operations force explicit handoffs and end conditions.

sequences.title: 새벽의 수위표
sequences.goal: Peak water and delayed city callback test whether distributed decisions hold together.

sequences.title: 문을 다시 여는 사람들
sequences.goal: Morning resolves the immediate emergency while leaving concrete future owners and institutional changes.
